fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.notes: IHI 0022E is a wire-level / cycle-level bus protocol spec. It defines logical signal semantics and timing rules relative to ACLK only — no PDK-specific SDC, no floorplan / placement constraints, no clock-tree budget. Per-implementation timing closure (clock period, max skew, max fanout, IO standards) is the responsibility of the SoC integrator and is captured outside this protocol spec. ACE adds three snoop channels (AC/CR/CD) that follow the same single-clock, no-combinational-path-from-input-to-output rule as the inherited AXI channels — timing budgets for AC/CR/CD must be planned at integration time.

evidence.quote: Each AXI interface has a single clock signal, ACLK. All input signals are sampled on the rising edge of ACLK. All output signal changes can only occur after the rising edge of ACLK.
The standard AXI VALID/READY handshake rules apply.
